easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate another land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand and untapping Gaea's Cradle and the land tapped in step 2.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
